title: Long-term Support for Vulnerable in Community
what_it_is: Long-term Support for Vulnerable in Community

sections.label: Financial assistance schemes for impacted individuals
sections.summary: Those needing financial help may apply for ComCare, the COVID-19 Recovery Grant, or the CRG-Temporary scheme for those impacted by Heightened Alert measures.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Social and Family Development (Ms Sun Xueling) (for the Minister for Social and Family Development)
sentences.text: For those who require financial assistance, they may apply for ComCare assistance or the COVID-19 Recovery Grant (CRG).

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Social and Family Development (Ms Sun Xueling) (for the Minister for Social and Family Development)
sentences.text: To support employees and self-employed individuals who have been financially impacted by the current period of Heightened Alert measures, we have also implemented the CRG-Temporary (CRG-T) scheme to provide temporary financial support.

sections.label: Rough sleepers support network
sections.summary: For rough sleepers, there is the Partners Engaging and Empowering Rough Sleepers (PEERS) Network.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Social and Family Development (Ms Sun Xueling) (for the Minister for Social and Family Development)
sentences.text: For rough sleepers, there is the Partners Engaging and Empowering Rough Sleepers (PEERS) Network.

sections.label: Tissue sellers and cardboard collectors
sections.summary: Befriending groups from the Vulnerable-in-Community Network engage tissue sellers and cardboard collectors to find their needs and bring them into social support.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Social and Family Development (Ms Sun Xueling) (for the Minister for Social and Family Development)
sentences.text: For tissue sellers and cardboard collectors, befriending groups from the Vulnerable-in-Community (VIC) Network engage them to find out their needs and bring them into the social support system.

sections.label: MSF communications and vulnerable persons
sections.summary: MSF would invest more in communications so the vulnerable know where and how to get help.

sentences.speaker: Ms Denise Phua Lay Peng (Jalan Besar)
sentences.text: So, all the above for the Ministry's consideration.

sentences.speaker: Ms Sun Xueling
sentences.text: I agree that, where necessary and where possible, MSF would invest more in communications to ensure that the vulnerable in our community know where and how they can get help.

sections.label: Directing vulnerable persons to SSO officers
sections.summary: The most appropriate and effective way is to direct vulnerable persons to SSO officers so professional help is given.

sentences.speaker: Ms Sun Xueling
sentences.text: The most appropriate and effective way really is to introduce, to direct these vulnerable persons to our SSO officer so that professional help is given to the vulnerable persons.

sections.label: ComCare hotline and vernacular language
sections.summary: The ComCare hotline point will be brought back to MSF, and an MSF SSO officer able to communicate in the vernacular language will extend necessary help.

sentences.speaker: Ms Sun Xueling
sentences.text: On the third point that the Member raised, which is on the ComCare hotline, I will bring it back to MSF to discuss with them.

sentences.speaker: Ms Sun Xueling
sentences.text: At the end of the day, I would like to assure the Member that if there are vulnerable persons and individuals who need to communicate their issues in the vernacular language, we will make sure that we have an MSF SSO officer who is able to do so and to extend the help that is necessary to him or her.
